name: Yair Rodriguez

official.division_note: Featherweight. Last fought Apr 12, 2025 (UFC 314, decision over Patricio Pitbull). Withdrew injured from the Sep 12, 2026 Noche UFC main event; reported (not yet official on Nov 6) vs Steve Garcia at UFC 335, Dec 12, 2026.

photo_coverage: Good for the face; 11 photos. Front: ESPN studio headshot (Apr 2025), UFC 314 media day (Apr 2025, reference-only) and a 2016 CC0 Mexico City photo. Three-quarter: Apr 2025 ceremonial weigh-in, Feb 2024 beside Ortega, a second 2016 CC0 photo. Profile: Apr 2025 faceoff and the 2016 CC0 signing photo (both his right side). Physique: Apr 2025 official weigh-in and two ESPN cutouts (Jul 2023, Apr 2025). No 2026 photo exists because he has not fought or done fight-week media since April 2025. Embed-ok: only the three 2016 CC0 photos (ten years old, shorter beard).

face.shape: Long, fairly narrow oval with high cheekbones and lean, slightly hollow cheeks; the trimmed beard squares off the lower outline. The face reads long against its width in every front view.
face.jaw: Lean and moderately wide under the beard; the jaw angles sit high and are not heavy.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly long, hidden under the beard, which ends in a soft rounded point.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, with a visible hollow below them (clearest in the April 2025 weigh-in and the studio headshot).
face.brow_ridge: Moderate. The brows sit low and close over the eyes, giving a serious, slightly frowning resting look.
face.forehead: Medium-high and fairly broad, with faint horizontal lines.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium-small, slightly deep-set under a heavy upper lid; faint creases under the eyes.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and nearly straight, a slight lift in the outer third and a short downward tail; inner ends fairly close.

nose.width: Medium: narrow bridge widening to a medium tip.
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly narrow from the front.
nose.hump: None to very slight; straight in the April 2025 right-side profile and the 2016 side view.
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly fleshy, pointing a little downward; medium nostrils.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; thin upper lip, medium lower lip. Neutral-serious at rest; a wide open smile with visible upper teeth in casual photos.

ears.protrusion: Stand out slightly from the head in every front view.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflower ear in the studio or 2025 photos.

face.notable_marks_scars: A faint curved line across the left cheek (his left) in the high-resolution studio headshot only; possibly a small scar or a crease (low confidence). No other obvious scars.

hair.style: Short taper on the sides and back with more length on top, combed up and back with a slight side sweep (2023 and 2025 studio shoots, April 2025 fight week).
hair.hairline: Rounded front with slightly recessed temple corners; no thinning.

facial_hair.colour: Black-brown, slightly browner at the edges; a few lighter (possibly grey) hairs show at the chin in the high-key studio headshot.
facial_hair.colour_samples_note: Beard boxes mix in skin, so they read lighter than the hair; colour_hex is a judged value from these.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, moustache and jaw; full on the lower cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 8-12 mm in 2025; about 4-6 mm in 2016.
facial_hair.shape: Neatly trimmed full short beard joined to the moustache; crisp cheek line set fairly high (about level with the bottom of the nose at the sides); neckline trimmed above the Adam's apple.

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). The ESPN studio files are high-key and pink-warm; the April 2025 stage photos carry a yellow cast. Shadowed cheeks (his right cheek at the media day, #7e5527; his left cheek at the weigh-in, #9f6735) were left out.
skin.undertone: Warm golden-olive; tans evenly with no visible pink flush outside the studio grade.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible; faint forehead lines; possible faint scar line on the left cheek (see face).

body.build: Tall, long-limbed featherweight (180 cm, 180 cm reach): slim frame with long arms and legs.
body.body_fat_notes: Very lean at the April 2025 weigh-in: six-pack and serratus clearly visible, visible abs, little fat anywhere. The muscle is wiry rather than bulky.
body.shoulders: Moderate width, rounded delts, slight slope; not broad.
body.arms: Long and lean with defined biceps and veiny forearms.
body.legs_calves: Long legs, lean thighs, slim but defined calves (studio cutouts).
body.posture: Upright with relaxed shoulders. Moderate chest, forearm and leg hair.
body.notable_physique_traits: Long, slim kicker's frame; dark short beard; swept-up hair; no tattoos on the front.

tattoos.description: None visible on the chest, abdomen, arms or legs in the front-facing studio cutouts (2023, 2025) or the April 2025 weigh-in photos. His back is not seen clearly in any photo here.

accessories_seen: Gold chain with a round medallion (Feb 2024), red string bracelet on the right wrist (Apr 2025 weigh-in), beaded bracelets and a gold ring at the Apr 2025 media day.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC fight kit: green shorts with black and white slashes in the July 2023 interim-champion studio shoot; black and grey snake-print shorts in the April 2025 studio shoot; dark shorts with a pink, red and teal print at the UFC 314 ceremonial weigh-in. Usually walks out with a Mexican flag. Fight-night colour follows the corner.

render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 tinted #2a1e1b, low and fairly straight
render_hints.hair: short02 or short04 with tapered sides and about 4 cm swept up and back on top, tinted #1f1715
render_hints.beard: short full beard #2c1f19 with a crisp, fairly high cheek line

stance.source: data/scouting/yair-rodriguez.json (archetype kickboxer; tags head-kicks, spinning, leg-kicks, rangy; switch-kick KO of Andre Fili) plus general knowledge of his fight footage. Not measured from these photos: none shows him fighting.
stance.notes: Long, side-on, back-weighted kicker's stance with a low, extended lead hand; light and springy on the feet. Switches stance mainly to set up kicks; the switch rate is a judgement.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin and build; medium-high for face proportions (three usable front views, one from 2025); medium for the morph values. What to watch: (1) long, narrow face with high cheekbones, hollow cheeks and a neat, dense black-brown short beard with a crisp cheek line; (2) low, straight dark brows close over dark, slightly deep-set eyes; (3) long straight nose with a rounded, slightly drooping tip; (4) ears that stand out slightly; (5) tall, very lean, long-limbed body with no visible tattoos; (6) hair short at the sides with about 4 cm swept up and back on top. The stance block comes from data/scouting and general fight-footage knowledge, not from these photos. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 as in src/avatar3d.js; l-/r- values are symmetric. Reach equals height (71 in).
